travelPlans.title: Tokyo spring escape
travelPlans.summary: A balanced trip with direct flights, a design-forward hotel, food tours, and neighborhood walks.

items.title: Arrival and Kiyosumi
items.body: Land at Haneda, check in, and keep the afternoon easy around gardens and cafes.

items.title: Tsukiji and Ginza
items.body: Start with a market breakfast walk, then browse Ginza side streets.

items.title: Yanaka and Ueno
items.body: Spend the day on old-town lanes, museums, and a relaxed dinner.

travelPlans.title: London culture long weekend
travelPlans.summary: A walkable London plan with a nonstop flight from SF, a Bloomsbury base, museum time, markets, and classic neighborhoods.

items.title: Arrival and Bloomsbury
items.body: Land at Heathrow, check in, and keep the first afternoon easy with parks and a casual dinner.

items.title: Markets and museums
items.body: Start at Borough Market, cross the river, and spend the afternoon around the British Museum.

items.title: West End and hidden lanes
items.body: Explore Covent Garden, Seven Dials, and book an evening show.

items.title: Marais arrival

items.title: Left Bank art
items.body: Follow the art and pastry trail with time for galleries.
